grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: Family Photos and Numbers
instructions: 这是模拟练习材料，不是官方考试。听录音前先看问题。录音会播放两遍。根据录音内容选择正确答案或填空。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解释为中文。
transcript:
A: Hi, Lisa. Are these your family photos?
B: Yes, they are. This is my family. We are five people.
A: Five? Who are they?
B: My mother, my father, my brother, my sister, and me.
A: Is this your brother?
B: No, that's my cousin. My brother is ten. My cousin is twelve.
A: And your sister? How old is she?
B: She is eight. She has two cats.
A: Two cats? What are their names?
B: Their names are Mimi and Coco.
A: Do you have a pet?
B: No, I don't. But my brother has a dog. His dog is big.
A: Are your parents teachers?
B: My mother is a teacher. My father is a doctor.
A: Thanks, Lisa.
B: You're welcome.

questions.explanation: 录音中 Lisa 说“We are five people.”，意思是“我们五个人”，所以选“五口人”。

questions.prompt: 照片中十二岁的人是谁？
questions.explanation: Lisa 说“My cousin is twelve.”，即她的表亲十二岁，所以选“Lisa 的表哥/表弟”。

questions.prompt: Lisa 的妹妹有几只猫？请填数字。
questions.explanation: Lisa 说“She has two cats.”，数字是 two，所以填 two。

questions.prompt: Lisa 的妹妹的猫叫什么名字？
questions.explanation: Lisa 说“Their names are Mimi and Coco.”，所以选 Mimi and Coco。
questions.evidence: Their names are Mimi and Coco.

questions.explanation: Lisa 说“No, I don't.”，回答前面“Do you have a pet?”的问题，说明她没有宠物。

questions.prompt: Lisa 的哥哥有什么宠物？请填一个英文单词。
questions.explanation: Lisa 说“But my brother has a dog.”，所以填 dog。
questions.evidence: But my brother has a dog.

questions.prompt: Lisa 的妈妈是做什么工作的？
questions.explanation: Lisa 说“My mother is a teacher.”，所以她的妈妈是老师。

questions.prompt: Lisa 的爸爸是做什么工作的？
questions.explanation: Lisa 说“My father is a doctor.”，所以她的爸爸是医生。

grammar.title: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has
grammar.explanation: 英语中，表示“我们”用 we，表示“他们/她们/它们”用 they，be 动词都用 are。名词变复数一般加 -s，如 cat→cats。表示“我的”用 my，“你的”用 your，“他的”用 his，“她的”用 her。表示“有”，I/you/we/they 用 have，he/she/it 用 has。
grammar.example: We are five people. She has two cats.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：They ___ my parents.
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，be 动词用 are，所以选 are。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ___ a dog.
questions.explanation: 主语是 she，表示“有”用 has，所以选 has。

questions.prompt: 写出 cat 的复数形式。
questions.explanation: cat 是规则名词，复数直接加 -s，变成 cats。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：This is my brother. ___ name is Tom.
questions.explanation: my brother 是男性，表示“他的”用 His，所以选 His。
